name: capture_bulb_image_region
description: captureBulbImage ARM code region: the function that owns the message-driven stop edge and calls capture_image_with_Bulb. The binary is proprietary Benro firmware, never committed, supplied locally (see capture_bulb_image_region.bin.placeholder). This sidecar records only coordinates and hashes - no firmware content.

provenance.layout_note: Load at the original vaddr 0x20604: the function resolves globals with ldr rN,[pc,#imm] + add rN,pc,rN, whose literal-pool words are PC-relative deltas. code_address 0x20000 / code_size 0x35d000 map one range from .text through the end of .bss (0x37cea4 -> 0x37d000), because the function's pointer chains walk .got into .bss. A single mapping is required: Unicorn cannot map a range that straddles an already-mapped page.
provenance.stub_entries_note: All 17 BL sites resolved from the retained source ELF: 9 via .symtab FUNC entries and 8 via .rel.plt -> .dynsym. model is call-site because the intercepted address is the BL inside the mapped blob.
provenance.boundary_aliases_note: The lifecycle cases assert on an idealised vocabulary. In this binary the message-driven stop edge is implemented by stopCaptureImageForMessage (0x202e4), called from captureBulbImage at 0x207e8. context_cancel has no counterpart here; gp_context_cancel (0x358d0) is libgphoto-internal with 27 call sites, none in this function.

observed_behaviour.interpretation: With .got and .data seeded from the retained binary and .bss mapped zero-filled, captureBulbImage runs to completion: 154 instructions, all 17 BL sites reached their stubs, and it returns normally. This is the first run of this artifact that executes the whole function rather than faulting partway.
observed_behaviour.superseded: An earlier revision recorded 84 instructions / 10 calls / UC_ERR_READ_UNMAPPED at 0x20750. That was without global seeding; the fault was a zero-filled .got entry, not missing behaviour.

memory_patches.why: Link-time GOT contents. The fault at 0x20750 was ldr r3,[r3] with r3 derived from [r4+0x564], i.e. .got+0x564, which holds 0x3787dc - a .bss address with no dynamic relocation, so the file value is final. Zero-filled, that load dereferences 0.
Initialised data the function reads through the same pointer chains.

provenance.memory_patches_note: Both ranges lie inside the code mapping, so they are patched in place rather than mapped. .bss is deliberately left zero-filled: that is what a real process gives it. Sources are resolved from POLARIS_FIRMWARE_ROOT by basename and verified against source_binary_sha256 before use; no absolute host path is recorded here.

call_edge_inventory.method: Disassembled the 684-byte region with capstone CS_MODE_ARM from the retained ELF and resolved every BL target against .symtab and .rel.plt. Independent of the emulator, so it confirms the stub_entries list rather than inheriting it.
call_edge_inventory.absent_edges_evidence: No BL to any close/cancel symbol exists in the region. Cross-checked by scanning all 721,500 instructions of the executable PT_LOAD for callers of gp_context_cancel (26 callers, all gp_filesystem_* / folder helpers), gp_port_close (4 callers: gp_camera_exit, gp_port_free, cb_arg_run, $a) and stopCaptureImageForMessage (2 callers: captureBulbImage, sonyBurstEvent). No function in this binary contains both a stop edge and a close or cancel edge.
call_edge_inventory.significance: Lifecycle cases 1-3 assert on close/cancel/context_cancel. Those edges are genuinely absent from this artifact - not unresolved, since all 17 BL sites are accounted for. The assertions encode issue #251's spec and must not be deleted to make the suite green; they are reported as not-evaluated instead.
